subject: Request: MAP retarget & evaluation hold (Acme)
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP retarget & evaluation hold (Acme)

Jonas —

Quick update from our side: the budget committee just flagged the Q3 line item and procurement has pushed our internal approval by ~3 weeks (expected sign-off now targeted for 7/21 instead of 6/30). This directly impacts the MAP milestones and the evaluation window we planned for next week.

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood rebaseline the MAP so our go-live and evaluation phases shift out by ~3 weeks?
- We need an explicit fallback plan and a short canary so our security/regulatory test team can validate without blocking production.
- Procurement will need a short SOW addendum and an updated timeline to attach to their approval packet.

I attached the procurement notice for context. We understand this is short notice — we want to minimize churn on your side while keeping momentum. Please propose an updated MAP and a brief risk log we can share with our legal/procurement team.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Grant
VP Product, Acme Corp
[Attachment: procurement_notice.pdf (pdf)]
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP retarget & evaluation hold (Acme)

Olivia —

Thanks for the heads up and for sharing the procurement notice. Totally understand the need to shift the MAP rather than pause. Proposed changes below (we can iterate):

Proposed rebaseline summary (high level):
- New target sign: 2025-07-21 (your estimate) -> proposed go-live baseline: 2025-07-30 (gives us a 1-week buffer)
- Evaluation window: reduced to 7/30–8/13 (2-week canary -> 1-week full validation)
- Canary: 10% traffic on Dedicated pool, fallback to hosted model variant on error
- Contingency: standby dedicated capacity reserved (7/24–8/06) — cost estimate included in attachment

Action items I need from Acme to lock this down:
1) Confirm internal sign-off date (procurement target 7/21)
2) List of stakeholders who need the risk log / SOW addendum (legal, security, procurement POC)
3) Any regulatory test windows that must remain fixed (we can try to align)

I attached a short rebaseline proposal and cost delta for the standby capacity. Marissa, can you add the risk log and update the MAP spreadsheet? Karthik — tagging you for an SLA/canary ops nod.

I can pull a one-page exec summary and an SOW addendum draft if that helps procurement move faster.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_rebaseline_proposal_v1.pdf (pdf)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP retarget & evaluation hold (Acme)

Folks —

Adding a scoped risk log and an updated MAP spreadsheet. Key entries below (full log attached):
- Risk: Procurement delay -> Impact: MAP milestone slip -> Mitigation: Reserve dedicated pool (7/24–8/06), staged canary, incremental billing cap
- Risk: Security test overlap -> Impact: extended validation window -> Mitigation: provide isolated staging env with subset of data; security runbook handed to Acme security team
- Risk: Staffing (Acme test engineers) -> Impact: longer fix cycles -> Mitigation: Redwood will provide 4 hours/week of engineering support for first 4 weeks of canary

Acme MAP changes (attached spreadsheet):
- Move "Evaluation: phase 1" start to 7/30 and phase 2 to 8/06
- Canary traffic: 10% -> 25% after first 72 hours if no regressions

Please review the risk entries and confirm by EOD Friday (6/20) so we can get the SOW addendum into your procurement packet.

Attachments: risk_log_acme_20250616.md, Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: risk_log_acme_20250616.md (markdown)]
[Attachment: Acme_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procure@acme.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP retarget & evaluation hold (Acme)

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the clear mitigation plan. We reviewed the risk log and the updated MAP spreadsheet internally. We can accept the new baseline you proposed (go-live 7/30, evaluation window 7/30–8/13) and the standby capacity cadence.

Next items from our side:
- Procurement will attach your SOW addendum to the approval packet — please send the one-page exec summary and the addendum draft to procure@acme.com.
- Legal wants the fallback SLA language clarified (we prefer an automatic failover to hosted model variant, with a 1-hour RTO target for critical endpoints).
- We'll sign the SOW addendum via DocuSign once legal and procurement confirm the wording.

If you can push the addendum and exec summary today, that will help our procurement committee move the approval up a day or two.

Appreciate the extra engineering support offer — that will be helpful during canary.

Olivia
Olivia Grant
VP Product, Acme Corp
